name: Nanyang Academy of Fine Arts
summary: Singapore arts academy with six English-taught honours degrees in design, fine art, performance and music, entered by portfolio or audition.

ib.text: The IB Diploma is a listed entry qualification with no points or subjects set; you must authorise the IB to release your transcript to NAFA. Selection is by portfolio or audition plus interview.

noDeadline: Opens 1 October; closes when each programme is full

dates.label: Applications open for the August 2027 intake

programmes.name: Biophilic Design
programmes.about: Spatial design that joins nature, sustainability and human well-being, with a focus on regenerative futures, ecological thinking and Southeast Asian environmental contexts.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio of 10 to 15 pieces, a 250 to 300 word statement of intent and a group interview. No prior spatial design is needed.

programmes.name: Design Practice
programmes.about: A studio-based design degree where you specialise in 3-dimensional, communication, fashion or spatial design, with a five-week international placement in the second year.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio of 10 to 15 pieces, a 250 to 300 word statement of intent and a group interview.

programmes.name: Fine Art
programmes.about: An immersive studio degree across traditional and contemporary media, built on experimentation, critical enquiry and Southeast Asian perspectives.
programmes.selectionNote: A statement of about 500 words, a portfolio of 5 artworks with process visuals, and an interview. Declare any AI-generated work.

programmes.name: Performance Making
programmes.about: Pre-professional training in dance or theatre combined with interdisciplinary performance making, studio practice and professional productions.
programmes.selectionNote: Recorded monologue, dance solo or original work, then an interview. A separate route applies if you already hold a dance or theatre diploma.

programmes.name: Instrumental & Vocal Teaching
programmes.about: Prepares performer-educators through one-to-one tuition, ensembles, teaching practicum and mentorship, and technology-enabled teaching.
programmes.selectionNote: Two contrasting works on video (at least 5 minutes) for pre-screening, then a final audition if shortlisted.

programmes.name: Music
programmes.about: A four-year conservatoire degree with one-to-one principal study and pathways in performance, technology, research, or theory and composition, with placements in London and Beijing.
programmes.selectionNote: Video pre-screening, then a final audition with sight-reading, music theory and an interview.

notes: Degrees are conferred by the University of the Arts Singapore; the Bachelor of Music is jointly conferred with the Royal College of Music, London.
Applications close once a programme reaches full capacity, with outcomes announced progressively by mid-April 2027, so apply as soon as the window opens.
A seventh degree, BA (Hons) Contemporary Chinese Theatres, is taught in Mandarin; Tuition Grant eligibility depends on nationality and highest qualification, so quoted fees are without the grant.
